title: asset-gen batch: several outputs per run, discard, pixel grid, sheet mode
goal: Let one run produce and select among several images without regenerating the whole run, and add deterministic pixel-art and sheet post-processing. Batch uses repeated run_workflow into one run; a node n parameter is a later option decided by the gateway probe.

tasks.objective: Record whether the image gateway returns more than one image for n greater than 1, and which sizes it returns, with at most 2 low-quality generations that the user approved in the current task. The NineRouterImage node fixes n at 1 and keeps only the first image, so the probe reuses the node's request code outside ComfyUI, reads credentials at run time as the node does and prints none. Result goes to docs/plans/assetgen-batch/probe.md. NOT_RUN (no approval or no gateway) is a valid result and then the optional node-n item stays in the backlog.
tasks.grade_reason: a findings document; no product code
acceptance: probe.md states the observed result (images returned, sizes) or NOT_RUN with the reason
no credential, host address or URL appears in the file
at most 2 low-quality generations were made, and only on the user's explicit word

tasks.objective: Support several outputs in one run (repeat run_workflow, anchors keep working because the template keeps exactly one NineRouterImage). The engine already globs outputs/*.png in embed, defringe, manifest and qa, but the quality plugin fails any unrecorded outputs/*.png, so add assetgen.py discard --run --output N --reason that moves a PNG to outputs-rejected/ and records it, and finalize --discard-qa-fail that discards QA-FAIL outputs and re-runs qa for the rest. manifest lists the discards in spec.trace. Report which reviews became stale. Logic in a new scripts/assetgen/discard.py; update the gen-run schema for the trace entry and the quality plugin so discarded files are expected.
acceptance: a run with 4 outputs where 1 fails QA finalizes with 3 recorded outputs and the failing one in outputs-rejected/ and spec.trace
no PNG is deleted; a discard is reversible by moving the file back
gen-run-outputs passes for the batch run and fails for an unrecorded PNG left in outputs/
the one-image-per-run flow and anchor wiring behave exactly as before

tasks.objective: Deterministic pixel-art post-processing without AI upscaling: finalize --pixel-grid [--max-colors N] detects the pixel grid, downsamples to it and limits the palette (to the structured style palette when the style has one, else to N colours). Originals are kept in outputs-raw/, the step is recorded in pixelgrid.json, and a QA row png-pixel-grid exists only when pixelgrid.json is present. 8-bit PNGs only; any other depth is skipped untouched like defringe. Logic in a new scripts/assetgen/pixelgrid.py.
acceptance: a fixture upscaled by a known factor is detected and reduced to that grid; the result has at most N colours
non-8-bit PNGs are skipped with a recorded reason, originals are kept in outputs-raw/
runs without pixelgrid.json get no new QA row

tasks.objective: Experimental sheet generation for icons and sprites: sheet-hint --rows R --cols C prints the prompt snippet for prompt.md (so the prompt review still binds it) and slice --run cuts the sheet by content, not by fixed coordinates, into outputs that the manifest records, keeping the sheet itself under sheets/. A wrong cell count is a FAIL row. Fixtures use the real returned sizes recorded in skills/comfyui/SKILL.md (1322x1190, 1672x941, 2172x724). If cells merge on real-size fixtures the task stops at a documented limitation. Logic in a new scripts/assetgen/slicer.py.
acceptance: a 3x3 fixture sheet at each real returned size is cut into 9 recorded outputs
a sheet with merged or missing cells gives a FAIL row, not a silent partial result
slice runs before defringe inside finalize and the source sheet is never overwritten
the task states in its report whether sheet mode is usable on real gateway sizes

tasks.objective: Document batch, discard, pixel-grid and sheet mode in skills/asset-gen/SKILL.md, skills/comfyui/SKILL.md (rewrite the one-NineRouterImage pitfall: batch is repeated run_workflow, node n is optional) and skills/asset-style/SKILL.md where pixel art style applies, plus the domain doc. Add a backlog item to docs/plans/backlog.md: optional n parameter on the NineRouterImage node if probe.md shows gateway support, listing what it would touch. Keep every SKILL.md at most 160 lines and citations valid.
tasks.grade_reason: skill and doc text only; the verbs are tested in the earlier tasks
acceptance: skills-lint passes and skill-citations reports no MOVED or broken citation
the comfyui pitfall no longer says batch is impossible and names the repeated run_workflow approach
backlog.md carries the optional node-n item with the probe result
